vv47:2.1: Pītapāsādasayane pītāsane pītabhājane pītachatte pītarathe pītasse pītavījane, || ||
vv47:3.1: Kiṃ kammam akarī bhadde pubbe mānusake bhave devate pucchitācikkha kissa kammass' idaṃ phalan ti. || ||
vv47:4.1: Kosātakī nāma lat' atthi bhante tittikā anabhijjhitā tassā cattāri pupphāni thūpaṃ abhihariṃ ahaṃ. || ||
vv47:5.1: Satthu sarīraṃ uddissa vippasannena cetasā nāssa maggaṃ avekkhissaṃ na taggamanasā satī. || ||
vv47:6.1: Tato maṃ avadhī gāvī thūpaṃ appattamānasaṃ tañ cāhaṃ abhisañceyyaṃ bhiyyo nūna ito siyā. || ||
vv47:7.1: Tena kammena devinda Maghavā devakuñjara pahāya mānusaṃ dehaṃ tava sahavyatam āgatā ti. || ||
vv47:8.1: Idaṃ sutvā Tidasādhipati Maghavā devakuñjaro Tāvatiṃse pasādento Mātaliṃ etad abravi: || ||
vv47:9.1: Passa Mātali accheraṃ cittaṃ kammaphalaṃ idaṃ appakam pi kataṃ deyyaṃ puññaṃ hoti mahapphalaṃ. || ||
vv47:10.1: Natthi citte pasannamhi appakā nāma dakkhiṇā tathāgate vā sambuddhe atha vā tassa sāvake. || ||
vv47:11.1: Ehi Mātali amhe pi bhiyyo bhiyyo mahemase tathāgatassa dhātuyo sukho puññānam uccayo. || ||
vv47:12.1: Tiṭṭhante nibbute cāpi same citte samaṃ phalaṃ cetopaṇidhihetu hi sattā gacchanti suggatiṃ. || ||
vv47:13.1: Bahunnaṃ vata atthāya uppajjanti tathāgatā yattha kāraṃ karitvāna saggaṃ gacchanti dāyakā ti. || ||
